jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**
The Senior Financial Analyst position is responsible for financial analysis and reporting in the areas of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis. Additional responsibilities may include monthly reports; monitoring and analyzing financial, statistical, and operational data trends; and special projects as requested.  


This individual will work with the VP of Finance and Business Leaders to translate strategy into actionable plans, leverage in\-depth analysis to provide the story behind the numbers and respond to business changes with agility. Also providing analytical support to Operations through the creation and maintenance of various BI reports, analysis, PowerPoint presentations, data models, and analytical tools.  

**Responsibilities:*** Budgeting and Forecasting: Includes the preparation of appropriate analysis to support the development of financial guidelines as well as the development and implementation of financial planning schedules and procedures at all levels of the Company. Review and analyze budgets and make appropriate recommendations to management.
* Financial Analysis: Provide financial and analytical support to internal customers. Review and analyze actuals versus budget.
* Financial Reporting: Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive internal financial reporting package to support the monthly preparation of business unit, department and consolidated financial statements. This includes maintenance of hierarchies to keep reporting in sync. Work with ViewPoint \- Vista, Power BI, Smart Sheets and Prophix.
* Process Improvement: Identify and lead process improvement initiatives. Assist on cross\-functional teams, as required, to improve budgeting and financial reporting processes.
* Continuously seek new ways to leverage business data to offer fresh insights and aid decision making.
* Translate business strategies, initiatives, and projects into effective financial modeling.
* Act as Finance representative for cross\-functional projects
* Understand the business and information needs of business owners and translate those needs into BI/analytics/reporting requirements.
* Support the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, data mining, analyses, dashboards, PowerPoint presentations etc. that drive meaningful, timely, and actionable insights and can be easily interpreted by users.
* Work with Operations team and utilize data insights to help drive predictive operational behavior.

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field of study required.
* 5\+ years' relevant work experience in accounting, financial forecasting, reporting, and analysis


required. Experience in Construction accounting and/or public accounting preferred.* Ability to work in a fast\-paced unstructured environment; excellent financial skills; expertise


with financial reporting and analysis including balance sheets, profit and loss, return on asset
and investment, metrics and measurements, etc.
* Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, vlookups, and ODBC connections.
* Strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and organizational skills required. Must


demonstrate ability to successfully interact effectively with all levels in the organization.* High level of initiative and critical thinking to formulate business issues into analytical problems


and devise actionable solutions.* Ability to work cross functionally and support multiple senior level internal clients.
* Comfortable working with large volumes of data and diligence when managing detail.
* Time management and ability to complete work under tight deadlines.

 **Core Competencies:*** XLI Steward
* Managerial Courage
* Bridge Builder
* People Builder
* Continuous Learner
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Edge

  

**Compensation**:
In accordance with California pay transparency requirements, the base salary range for this position is $110,100 – $117,500 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. Total compensation may include a performance\-based bonus.

Senior Finance Analyst – GFG Finance, North America


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting\-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to work beyond the cutting\-edge, continuously pushing the boundaries of science and engineering to make possible the next generations of technology, join us to Make Possible a Better Future.


**Position Summary** :


We are seeking a highly skilled and results driven Senior Finance Analyst to join the Global Field group (GFG) finance team. This position reports into the Director, Finance and will partner with the Account General Managers (AGMs) in North America/ Europe to provide overall finance support, drive finance operating rhythm, spend governance and support the team in optimizing Days Sales Outstanding and cash flow improvement.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Primary finance partner and first point of contact for the Regional General Manager of North America and Field Operations leadership teams
* Lead quarterly and annual budgeting cycles, quarterly business reviews, scenario analysis, headcount modeling and quarter end close process. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather and validate financial data, ensuring accuracy and completeness
* Perform variance analysis, identify key drivers of financial performance, highlight risks and opportunities and provide insightful recommendations to guide management decision making
* Manage the cost allocation process to Business units and support the process of quarterly forecasts
* Support in analysis of Accounts Receivables and opportunities to improve days sales outstanding
* Work with the Account team in improving Install \& Warranty forecast process \& accuracy
* Support various ad\-hoc project analysis as required. Identify and implement improvements in finance processes
* Manage and guide the IBM Guadalajara (ACE) team in the weekly tracking \& cost management of North America and Field Operations groups

**Key Qualifications**

* Proficiency in financial planning and analysis and business partnering
* Strong data collation, manipulation, reporting and modeling skills. Experience with financial systems (SAP \& BPC ERP System, Tableau or Power BI) a plus
* Excellent influencing and customer relationship skills with an ability to collaborate broadly
* Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex financial information clearly and concisely.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment with minimal supervision
* Proactive, passionate, curious individual with strong desire to learn and grow
* Bachelor’s degree in business/accounting/finance or related field (Master's Degree/MBA Preferred)
* 4\-6 years of experience in corporate finance, FP\&A or accounting roles

Yes, 10% of the Time
**Relocation Eligible:**

Yes

---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. ----------------


We are seeking a Staff Financial Analyst to join the FP\&A team to support financial analysis, forecasting, and enhance financial reporting systems to improve company’s financial performance. * Support FP\&A strategic planning, annual operating plan, quarterly business reviews, and monthly close and forecast
* Detail reporting and analysis of revenue and margins by customer and product

**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**
As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion\-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high\-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second\-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  

  

**Minimum Requirements:**
* **Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.**
* **6\+ months of retail experience.**
* **Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.**
* **Must be authorized to work in the United States.**

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future\- you are impacting your own.
* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second\-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second\-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit\- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**
* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion\-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem\-solve together!
* **People**\-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**
* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions\- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day\- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

  

**Health \+ Wellbeing**
**We will:**
* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**
**We will:**
* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work \& life needs!

**Financial Health**
**We will:**
* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll \& an additional discretionary 2% at year\-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces\- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth \+ Development**
**We will:**
* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard \& throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**About Crossroads**
One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991\.  


Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell\-By\-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco\-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.  

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’
  

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.


**The Role:**

As the Senior Financial Analyst for the Logitech for Business (L4B) FP\&A team, you will act as the lead financial strategist and P\&L owner for our B2B organization.


In this highly collaborative role, you will hold full ownership of the P\&L—from Direct Customer Sales down to Contribution Margin. You will serve as the financial compass for the L4B team, aligning closely with cross\-functional stakeholders across the globe to decode P\&L dynamics, drive strategic decision\-making, and fuel our long\-term growth. If you are a proactive problem\-solver who thrives in a fast\-paced, innovative environment and loves transforming complex data into actionable business strategies, we want you on our team.


**Your Contribution:**

* Master the P\&L : Take full ownership of the L4B P\&L from top\-line sales down to Contribution Margin, partnering across functions to deeply understand and influence the drivers of our financial performance.
* Drive Long\-Term Financial Planning (LTFP): Own and evolve the LTFP model. You will coordinate inputs from key stakeholders (including Services, Category Marketing, and Operations), dynamically update the model to reflect near\-term planning cycles, and proactively highlight performance gaps and opportunities.
* Lead Regional Target Setting \& Tracking: Act as the vital bridge between Global HQ and Regional finance partners. You will cascade HQ targets to the regions, establish key performance metrics, and track ongoing regional execution against our strategic goals.
* Empower Category Marketing \& Pricing: Provide robust financial oversight for Category Marketing. You will lead global pricing analytics, scenario modeling, and performance tracking to optimize our competitive positioning and profitability.
* Manage Financial Forecasting: Own and execute HQ\-level forecast adjustments, ensuring high accuracy, agility, and alignment with broader corporate objectives.
* Deliver Strategic Support: Act as a trusted financial advisor to category and product management leaders. You will provide advanced financial modeling and strategic business casing for special initiatives, product launches, and new business opportunities.

**Your Qualifications and Skills:**

* Experience: 5\+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Finance, FP\&A, or Investment Banking. Prior experience supporting a B2B, hardware, or technology business is highly preferred.
* Financial Modeling Expertise: Exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills. You can build complex, dynamic models from scratch and synthesize large datasets into clear, actionable business insights.
* Financial Planning and CRM System Experience: expertise in using various financial analytics tools such as OneStream, Hyperion Essbase, Analplan and Salesforce.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

**Compensation:**

This position offers an annual base salary typically between $100,000 and $125,000\. In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.
 

Logitech offers benefits such as Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, Traditional and Roth 401(k) Plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), Basic and Additional Life Insurance, Disability Coverage, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, Tuition Reimbursement Plans, Commuter Benefits, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Parental Leave.


Logitech also offers Wellness Programs, Health Savings Account Plans, access to Expert Medical Opinions, Identity Theft Protection, Breast Milk Delivery to Nursing Mothers on Business Travel, access to a Group Legal Plan, Donations Matching Programs, Employee Product Discounts, and access to Auto, Home, and Pet Insurance.


\#LI\-TM1


Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in\-house.
  

  

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!  



  

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 09/28/2026
  
Meet the Team
  
  

The Financial Health team helps Cisco plan spending, manage budgets, and use resources effectively. Our work includes budgeting, forecasting, following financial policies, and automating routine tasks. We partner with Finance and Marketing to turn financial data into clear information that supports business decisions. Our team works together to maintain accurate financial records and improve how work gets done. Joining this team gives you the opportunity to help Cisco improve financial planning and support business growth.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

Track operating costs and spending on long\-term assets against approved budgets so budget owners can identify and address differences. Support monthly and quarterly financial reviews by processing purchase requests and invoices, recording costs incurred but not yet billed, and checking that purchasing records match accounting records. Maintain employee count, spending, and forecast data in Hyperion, and explain differences between planned and actual results. Prepare reports that help Finance and Marketing partners understand spending trends, update forecasts, and decide where to take action. Improve recurring financial processes to reduce manual work and errors, with success measured by accurate records, reports delivered on schedule, and completion of required financial checks.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree in in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or coursework in finance, accounting, or statistics.
* 3\+ years of experience in business operations, financial analysis, or a role that includes budget tracking and financial reporting.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, apply lookup and conditional formulas, and build spreadsheets that calculate spending totals and forecasts.
* Experience completing monthly or quarterly financial reporting activities, including comparing actual spending with budgets, updating forecasts, and checking purchasing records against accounting records.
* Experience preparing financial reports that identify differences between planned and actual spending, explain the causes, and recommend corrective actions.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience using SAP or Oracle to review purchasing and accounting records, and Hyperion to maintain budgets or forecasts.
* Experience building reports or charts in Tableau or Power BI to track spending, budgets, or forecasts.
* Experience using SQL to retrieve and combine data from databases.
* Experience completing a process improvement that reduced processing time, manual steps, or errors, with results that can be described or measured.
* Experience presenting financial findings to colleagues outside Finance and working with them to agree on actions, owners, and deadlines.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About the Role As an Identity and Access Management Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting the team along with a team of cross\-functional cyber, privacy, engineering, and data protection analysts to define, implement, manage, and measure controls to protect data in accordance with USDS policies and standards relevant to geographical regulations, contractual commitments, and confidentiality requirements. The Identity and Access Management Analyst will play a pivotal role in operationalization of the identity ecosystem and access management programs in USDS. jobs.description:
**Mercantile Buyer**

**Location:** Winchester Mystery House – San Jose, CA – Hybrid partial onsite/ partial remote  
**Employment Type:** Part\-Time, approximately 10–20 hours per week  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Reports To:** Sr. Marketing Manager

**Position Summary**

The Mercantile Buyer is responsible for developing and maintaining a compelling, profitable, and distinctive merchandise assortment for the Winchester Mystery House. This position combines retail buying and procurement expertise with a strong appreciation for history, storytelling, design, and the unique character of the Winchester Mystery House.

The Buyer will identify, source, evaluate, and purchase merchandise that appeals to the property's diverse visitor base while supporting the Winchester Mystery House brand, seasonal programming, special events, and overall guest experience.

**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Financial Analyst and become a vital contributor to our strategic financial planning and decision\-making processes. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in financial analysis, accounting principles, and regulatory standards to provide insightful reports, forecasts, and recommendations that drive business success. Your proactive approach and analytical skills will support our commitment to financial excellence and operational efficiency, empowering us to navigate complex markets with confidence. This position offers an exciting opportunity for motivated professionals eager to make a tangible impact through data\-driven insights and strategic financial management.

**Duties**

* Develop comprehensive financial projection models to support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning initiatives.
* Conduct variance analysis reporting to identify discrepancies between actuals and forecasts, providing actionable insights for management.
* Prepare and interpret financial statements in accordance with GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards).
* Perform detailed cost accounting analyses to optimize expense management and improve profit margins.
* Support regulatory reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with SOX (Sarbanes\-Oxley Act) controls and other statutory obligations.
* Utilize business intelligence tools and financial reporting software to streamline data analysis and enhance reporting accuracy.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on pricing strategies, sales performance, investment evaluations, and financial planning efforts.
* Conduct technical accounting research on complex transactions such as revenue recognition, lease accounting, or financial instrument valuation.
* Analyze profit \& loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports to provide clear interpretations for stakeholders.
* Assist in the development of financial models that forecast future performance based on market trends and organizational goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or CFA certification is a plus.
* Proven experience in corporate accounting, public accounting, or financial analysis roles with a strong understanding of financial concepts.
* Extensive knowledge of IFRS, GAAP, SOX compliance, and regulatory reporting standards.
* Demonstrated expertise in financial model development using Excel data analysis techniques.
* Proficiency with financial analysis software and business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills for preparing clear financial report writing and interpretation for diverse audiences.
* Experience in variance analysis reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes.
* Data analysis skills combined with a solid understanding of finance principles to support decision\-making initiatives.

Embark on a rewarding career where your analytical acumen drives impactful business outcomes!

Blake Willson Group (BWG) unites deep domain experts with technologists who leverage industry\-leading financial management solutions to address the most critical mission objectives. Headquartered in the National Capital Region, the firm delivers measurable outcomes through technology\-forward strategies and advanced solutions that drive mission success.



Blake Willson Group has a distinguished track record of exceptional performance, achieving operational efficiencies that allow our clients to do more with less. BWG has earned the confidence of its clients by consistently exceeding expectations through its unwavering commitment to best value solutions, implemented with speed.

**Job Location:**



This role is 100% remote.


**Clearance:**



Must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust Security Clearance.


**Job Description:**



Blake Willson Group is seeking a Senior Federal Financial Analyst to support federal clients with complex accounting, financial reporting, budgetary accounting, and financial management requirements. The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on experience applying FASAB accounting standards and federal financial management requirements, with particular expertise in budgetary accounting, Standard General Ledger (USSGL) relationships, Statement of Budgetary Resources (SBR), and Governmentwide Treasury Account Symbol Adjusted Trial Balance System (GTAS) reporting. In this position, you will also:


* Apply FASAB accounting standards and federal financial management requirements to complex accounting and financial reporting issues.
* Support federal budgetary accounting, including SBR reporting, GTAS submissions, and budgetary/proprietary account relationships.
* Analyze accounting and financial data, general and subsidiary ledgers, and Treasury data to identify discrepancies, abnormal balances, and reporting issues.
* Research and resolve accounting issues through root\-cause analysis, reconciliations, and appropriate remediation strategies.
* Develop, document, and recommend adjusting journal entries (AJEs) and other accounting corrections.
* Support financial statement preparation, audit readiness, and remediation of audit and internal control findings.
* Evaluate financial and operational processes and recommend improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
* Develop analyses, financial models, workpapers, memoranda, presentations, and other client deliverables to support actionable recommendations.
* Independently manage assigned workstreams and coordinate with clients, project leadership, auditors, and functional teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
* Provide technical guidance and quality control to junior and mid\-level staff while supporting broader program objectives.


**Required Skills:**


* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in federal accounting or financial management, including FASAB and budgetary accounting.
* 3\+ years of experience with SBR, GTAS, general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and accounting issue remediation.
* 3\+ years of experience analyzing financial data, developing or recommending AJEs, and providing supportable accounting recommendations.


**Desired Skills:**


* Experience supporting federal agencies with financial statement preparation, audit readiness, or audit remediation.
* Experience working with USSGL accounts, Treasury Account Symbols (TAS), and federal financial management systems.
* Experience developing financial models, analytical workpapers, or data\-driven recommendations.
* Experience supporting federal internal controls and remediation of audit findings.

jobs.title: Administrative Analyst (Logistics)
jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work; however, they must physically reside within the Sacramento region or have the ability to regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**  

Under the direction of a Program Specialist, the Administrative Analyst for the Logistics Section of the Department of Utilities is responsible for administering highly visible department\-wide solicitation, contract, and accounts payable processes necessary for the purchase of critical goods and services to ensure essential operation of the City’s extensive water, wastewater, and storm drainage system infrastructure. The Administrative Analyst will ensure compliance with City procurement policies, prevailing wage, and labor compliance requirements. The Administrative Analyst may also support other Logistics program areas as such as Fleet and Facilities.  

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT**  

  

The ideal candidate will have experience procuring goods and services through within the procure to pay lifecycle , which may include bids and solicitations, contracts, writing council reports, requesting and updating purchase orders, and other procurement functions. Experience working with governmental procurement is preferred but not required. They will be self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and have excellent communication, analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. They will have the ability to navigate software databases, perform research, and compile and analyze complex data, including financial data to make recommendations consistent with City Policies and Code. Experience with fiscal management software is desired but not required. The ideal candidate will work closely with stakeholders and will have the ability to build and manage strong relationships internally and externally.  

  

This journey\-level classification is populated with multiple incumbents. Incumbents may be assigned to perform either the entire range of support functions and administrative and technical duties for a division or department or a broad range of functional program management duties for programs with department or Citywide impact. Responsibilities require a complete knowledge of departmental policies, programmatic, or project operating policies and procedures. The Administrative Analyst may specialize in one program area or may have broader responsibility for multiple internal service functions. Incumbents may independently perform moderately complex professional or program management work and make independent decisions on routine activities; or may perform complex professional or program management work under closer direction and exercise less independent judgment and discretion. The Administrative Analyst is distinguished from the next higher\-level class of Administrative Officer in that the latter is responsible for the administration and management of programs and projects or all centralized administrative services for a department or major division with high visibility and substantial Citywide impact.  

  

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**  

General direction is provided by higher\-level department or division administrative personnel. Responsibilities may include the indirect supervision of technical and clerical personnel.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


* Performs professional analytical and technical work in the formulation and administration of department or division budgets, development, and management of grants and contracts, management of department level procurement, or coordination of personnel functions.
* Performs research and analysis in the development of program or project activities, including program compliance and eligibility, regulatory issues, and funding requirements.
* Compiles and analyzes data and makes recommendations on the formulation of policy, procedures, staffing, and organizational changes; conducts surveys and performs research and statistical analysis on administrative, fiscal, personnel, or operational problems.
* Compiles materials and assists in the preparation of program\-related grants, budgets, reports, manuals, and publications; coordinates procurement activities and related support functions for a program or project.
* Analyzes information for preparation of grants, contracts, and agreements; assists in negotiating terms; implements, monitors, and prepares reports on conduct and performance; prepares statistical data and graphs.
* Performs research and prepares studies as required; conducts surveys, compiles and analyzes data and formulates program policies and procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and outcomes; prepares periodic or specialized reports of program activities.
* Participates and assists in the design, implementation, and installation of new and revised programs, systems, procedures, methods of operation, and forms.
* Coordinates and monitors the administrative functions of an assigned department; compiles materials and assists in the preparation of budgets, reports, manuals, and publications.
* Coordinates departmental activities and programs with other City departments and divisions, and with outside agencies; represents the assigned department in committee meetings; oversees contract service providers.
* Responds to complaints and requests for information; interprets and applies policies and procedures; adjudicates complaints.
* Makes complex program or project eligibility determinations; conducts focus groups; meets with community or business groups.
* Prepares oral reports; makes oral presentations to a variety of City and departmental committees.
* May train staff as assigned.
* Provides exceptional customer service to those contacted in the course of work.
* Other related duties may also be performed; not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to join our team and drive strategic financial insights that support our company's growth and operational excellence. In this pivotal role, you will analyze complex financial data, develop accurate financial models, and interpret financial statements to inform decision\-making at the highest levels. * Support internal controls by ensuring SOX compliance across financial processes and systems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning initiatives utilizing business intelligence tools.

**Skills**

* Extensive knowledge of SOX compliance requirements and regulatory reporting standards such as GAAP and IFRS.
* Strong background in corporate accounting, public accounting, and technical accounting principles.
* Proven experience in financial model development, including financial forecasting analysis and business intelligence integration.
* Proficiency in financial software platforms and advanced Excel data analysis techniques.
* Expertise in variance analysis reporting, profit \& loss management, and financial statement interpretation.
* Skilled in data analysis skills with the ability to develop comprehensive financial report writing for executive audiences.
* Demonstrated organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy under tight deadlines.

* Location: On\-site at Field Fresh Foods


About Us
  
At Field Fresh Foods, we are passionate about delivering the freshest, highest\-quality produce to our customers. As a trusted industry leader, we specialize in providing customized fresh food solutions to restaurants, retailers, and food service providers. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability drives everything we do.
  
We believe in fostering a collaborative, dynamic, and growth\-oriented work environment where employees are empowered to take ownership of their roles and make a real impact. At Field Fresh Foods, you won’t just have a job—you’ll build a fulfilling career with opportunities for advancement, professional development, and a supportive team that values your contributions. If you’re looking to join a company that values hard work, fresh ideas, and operational excellence, we’d love to have you on board!
  
Job Summary
  
As a Procurement \- Purchasing Agent at Field Fresh Foods, you will play a key role in ensuring the timely and cost\-effective procurement of fresh produce, raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other goods needed to support our operations. You will work closely with suppliers and internal departments to maintain appropriate inventory levels, manage purchase orders, monitor market conditions, and ensure materials meet our expectations for quality, cost, availability, and service.
  
The ideal candidate is a strong negotiator and analytical problem\-solver who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. This position requires excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to balance cost, quality, inventory, and changing operational demands while developing strong supplier relationships.
  
What You’ll Do
  
* Purchase fresh produce, raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other products required to support daily operations.
* Create, process, and manage purchase orders, ensuring accuracy of quantities, pricing, specifications, and delivery requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels, usage, forecasts, and production requirements to determine purchasing needs and prevent shortages or excess inventory.
* Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring expectations for quality, pricing, availability, and service are consistently met.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, lead times, and other purchasing conditions to achieve competitive costs and favorable business terms.
* Monitor market conditions, commodity pricing, seasonal availability, and supply trends that may impact purchasing decisions.
* Source and evaluate new and alternative suppliers to improve cost, quality, service, and supply continuity.
* Compare supplier quotes and conduct cost and pricing analysis to support informed purchasing decisions.
* Coordinate with Production, Operations, Sales, Quality, Receiving, and Finance to ensure materials are available when needed.
* Track open purchase orders and communicate with suppliers regarding delivery schedules, shortages, substitutions, and delays.
* Work with internal teams and suppliers to resolve quality, quantity, pricing, receiving, and invoice discrepancies.
* Assist with managing product substitutions and supply interruptions while minimizing disruption to operations and customers.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, pricing, and supporting documentation.
* Analyze purchasing and supplier data using Excel and other reporting tools to identify trends, savings opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, inventory management, cost control, and supplier performance.
* Support company initiatives related to cost savings, waste reduction, quality, and operational efficiency.


What You Bring to the Table
  
**✅ Experience:** Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, inventory management, produce, food manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
  
**✅ Purchasing Skills:** Understanding of purchase orders, supplier management, inventory requirements, pricing, lead times, and purchasing processes.
  
**✅ Negotiation Skills:** Ability to effectively negotiate pricing, terms, availability, and service expectations while maintaining positive supplier relationships.
  
**✅ Analytical Thinking:** Ability to evaluate pricing, inventory, usage, market conditions, and supplier performance to make sound purchasing decisions.
  
**✅ Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with ERP, purchasing, inventory, or supply chain systems.
  
**✅ Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal departments.
  
**✅ Problem\-Solving Mindset:** Ability to respond quickly to shortages, changing demand, supplier issues, and other supply challenges while developing practical solutions.
  
**✅ Organization:** Ability to manage multiple suppliers, purchase orders, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
  
**✅ Attention to Detail:** Strong commitment to accuracy when reviewing pricing, quantities, specifications, purchase orders, and supplier documentation.
  
**✅ Teamwork:** Ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Production, Sales, Quality, Receiving, and Finance to support company goals.
  
Why Join Field Fresh Foods?
  
We know that great employees are the foundation of our success, and we’re committed to providing a rewarding and supportive work environment. Here’s what we offer:
  
* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
* 401(k) to help you plan for the future
* Employee discounts on fresh products
* On\-Demand Pay – Access your earnings when you need them
* Opportunities for growth and professional development

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------



Spectrum Building Services of America is a growing commercial facilities services company serving major national and regional customers across multiple U.S. markets.



We are looking for an experienced **Senior Financial Analyst, FP\&A** to join our finance team. This is not a bookkeeping or data\-entry position. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers, investigating why financial results changed, building financial models, and turning financial and operational data into useful information for management.



The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, accounting team, and operational leadership to provide accurate, timely, and insightful financial analysis.


**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Senior Financial Analyst will be responsible for financial planning and analysis, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial statement analysis, profitability analysis, cash\-flow forecasting, and financial modeling.



A major responsibility of this position is **cause\-of\-change and root\-cause analysis**.



We do not simply want reports showing that an expense increased or profitability declined. We expect the analyst to investigate the underlying data, determine what caused the change, quantify the major drivers, identify items requiring further investigation, and clearly communicate the findings.



You should be comfortable receiving financial information and independently asking:


* What changed?


* Why did it change?


* Does the result make sense?


* Is this an accounting issue or an actual business result?


* What are the major drivers?


* What should management pay attention to?


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Financial Statement Analysis**


* Perform monthly P\&L analysis comparing actual results to budget, forecast, prior month, and prior year.

* Support preparation of the annual company budget.


* Maintain rolling financial forecasts.


* Update forecasts based on actual results and changing business assumptions.


* Build revenue, labor, supply, overhead, EBITDA, and cash\-flow forecasts.


* Maintain forecast models and supporting schedules.


* Compare actual results against forecasts and explain significant differences.


### **Cash\-Flow Forecasting**


* Prepare and maintain short\- and medium\-term cash\-flow forecasts.

* Market/geography


* Business unit


* Other relevant operating segments

* Labor hours


* Wage rates


* Overtime


* Supplies


* Pricing


* Revenue changes


* Operating expenses


* Productivity


### **Month\-End Close \& Management Reporting**



Work with the accounting team during month\-end close to:


* Review preliminary financial results.


* Perform analytical review of the P\&L and balance sheet.


* Identify unusual balances or transactions.


* Prepare supporting financial schedules.


* Track questions and exceptions requiring accounting investigation.


* Confirm that identified issues have been addressed before management reporting is finalized.


* Prepare the monthly management financial package.



The Senior Financial Analyst supports the close process through analysis and review. Accounting ownership and final accounting entries remain with the accounting function.


### **Financial Modeling \& Decision Support**



Build financial models to evaluate business decisions, including:


* New customer opportunities


* Contract pricing


* Wage increases


* Customer price increases


* Hiring decisions


* Capital investments


* Equipment and technology investments


* Cost\-reduction initiatives


* Changes in operating assumptions



Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis to show management how different assumptions affect revenue, profitability, EBITDA, and cash flow.


### **Business \& Operational Analysis**



Analyze financial and operating data to identify opportunities and risks involving:


* Labor


* Supplies


* Workers’ compensation


* Customer profitability


* Operating efficiency


* Pricing


* Overhead


* Productivity



Support management with ad hoc financial and business analysis as requested.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



The successful analyst does more than prepare spreadsheets.



For example, instead of reporting:

new_jobs.title: Administrative Analyst (Logistics)
new_jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------


**With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work; however, they must physically reside within the Sacramento region or have the ability to regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.**  

Under the direction of a Program Specialist, the Administrative Analyst for the Logistics Section of the Department of Utilities is responsible for administering highly visible department\-wide solicitation, contract, and accounts payable processes necessary for the purchase of critical goods and services to ensure essential operation of the City’s extensive water, wastewater, and storm drainage system infrastructure. The Administrative Analyst will ensure compliance with City procurement policies, prevailing wage, and labor compliance requirements. The Administrative Analyst may also support other Logistics program areas as such as Fleet and Facilities.  

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT**  

  

The ideal candidate will have experience procuring goods and services through within the procure to pay lifecycle , which may include bids and solicitations, contracts, writing council reports, requesting and updating purchase orders, and other procurement functions. Experience working with governmental procurement is preferred but not required. They will be self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and have excellent communication, analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. They will have the ability to navigate software databases, perform research, and compile and analyze complex data, including financial data to make recommendations consistent with City Policies and Code. Experience with fiscal management software is desired but not required. The ideal candidate will work closely with stakeholders and will have the ability to build and manage strong relationships internally and externally.  

  

This journey\-level classification is populated with multiple incumbents. Incumbents may be assigned to perform either the entire range of support functions and administrative and technical duties for a division or department or a broad range of functional program management duties for programs with department or Citywide impact. Responsibilities require a complete knowledge of departmental policies, programmatic, or project operating policies and procedures. The Administrative Analyst may specialize in one program area or may have broader responsibility for multiple internal service functions. Incumbents may independently perform moderately complex professional or program management work and make independent decisions on routine activities; or may perform complex professional or program management work under closer direction and exercise less independent judgment and discretion. The Administrative Analyst is distinguished from the next higher\-level class of Administrative Officer in that the latter is responsible for the administration and management of programs and projects or all centralized administrative services for a department or major division with high visibility and substantial Citywide impact.  

  

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**  

General direction is provided by higher\-level department or division administrative personnel. Responsibilities may include the indirect supervision of technical and clerical personnel.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


* Performs professional analytical and technical work in the formulation and administration of department or division budgets, development, and management of grants and contracts, management of department level procurement, or coordination of personnel functions.
* Performs research and analysis in the development of program or project activities, including program compliance and eligibility, regulatory issues, and funding requirements.
* Compiles and analyzes data and makes recommendations on the formulation of policy, procedures, staffing, and organizational changes; conducts surveys and performs research and statistical analysis on administrative, fiscal, personnel, or operational problems.
* Compiles materials and assists in the preparation of program\-related grants, budgets, reports, manuals, and publications; coordinates procurement activities and related support functions for a program or project.
* Analyzes information for preparation of grants, contracts, and agreements; assists in negotiating terms; implements, monitors, and prepares reports on conduct and performance; prepares statistical data and graphs.
* Performs research and prepares studies as required; conducts surveys, compiles and analyzes data and formulates program policies and procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and outcomes; prepares periodic or specialized reports of program activities.
* Participates and assists in the design, implementation, and installation of new and revised programs, systems, procedures, methods of operation, and forms.
* Coordinates and monitors the administrative functions of an assigned department; compiles materials and assists in the preparation of budgets, reports, manuals, and publications.
* Coordinates departmental activities and programs with other City departments and divisions, and with outside agencies; represents the assigned department in committee meetings; oversees contract service providers.
* Responds to complaints and requests for information; interprets and applies policies and procedures; adjudicates complaints.
* Makes complex program or project eligibility determinations; conducts focus groups; meets with community or business groups.

* Provides exceptional customer service to those contacted in the course of work.

About Us
  
At Field Fresh Foods, we are passionate about delivering the freshest, highest\-quality produce to our customers. As a trusted industry leader, we specialize in providing customized fresh food solutions to restaurants, retailers, and food service providers. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability drives everything we do.
  
We believe in fostering a collaborative, dynamic, and growth\-oriented work environment where employees are empowered to take ownership of their roles and make a real impact. At Field Fresh Foods, you won’t just have a job—you’ll build a fulfilling career with opportunities for advancement, professional development, and a supportive team that values your contributions. If you’re looking to join a company that values hard work, fresh ideas, and operational excellence, we’d love to have you on board!
  
Job Summary
  
As a Procurement \- Purchasing Agent at Field Fresh Foods, you will play a key role in ensuring the timely and cost\-effective procurement of fresh produce, raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other goods needed to support our operations. You will work closely with suppliers and internal departments to maintain appropriate inventory levels, manage purchase orders, monitor market conditions, and ensure materials meet our expectations for quality, cost, availability, and service.
  
The ideal candidate is a strong negotiator and analytical problem\-solver who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. This position requires excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to balance cost, quality, inventory, and changing operational demands while developing strong supplier relationships.
  
What You’ll Do
  
* Purchase fresh produce, raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other products required to support daily operations.
* Create, process, and manage purchase orders, ensuring accuracy of quantities, pricing, specifications, and delivery requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels, usage, forecasts, and production requirements to determine purchasing needs and prevent shortages or excess inventory.
* Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring expectations for quality, pricing, availability, and service are consistently met.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, lead times, and other purchasing conditions to achieve competitive costs and favorable business terms.
* Monitor market conditions, commodity pricing, seasonal availability, and supply trends that may impact purchasing decisions.
* Source and evaluate new and alternative suppliers to improve cost, quality, service, and supply continuity.
* Compare supplier quotes and conduct cost and pricing analysis to support informed purchasing decisions.
* Coordinate with Production, Operations, Sales, Quality, Receiving, and Finance to ensure materials are available when needed.
* Track open purchase orders and communicate with suppliers regarding delivery schedules, shortages, substitutions, and delays.
* Work with internal teams and suppliers to resolve quality, quantity, pricing, receiving, and invoice discrepancies.
* Assist with managing product substitutions and supply interruptions while minimizing disruption to operations and customers.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, pricing, and supporting documentation.
* Analyze purchasing and supplier data using Excel and other reporting tools to identify trends, savings opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, inventory management, cost control, and supplier performance.
* Support company initiatives related to cost savings, waste reduction, quality, and operational efficiency.


What You Bring to the Table
  
**✅ Experience:** Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, inventory management, produce, food manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
  
**✅ Purchasing Skills:** Understanding of purchase orders, supplier management, inventory requirements, pricing, lead times, and purchasing processes.
  
**✅ Negotiation Skills:** Ability to effectively negotiate pricing, terms, availability, and service expectations while maintaining positive supplier relationships.
  
**✅ Analytical Thinking:** Ability to evaluate pricing, inventory, usage, market conditions, and supplier performance to make sound purchasing decisions.
  
**✅ Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with ERP, purchasing, inventory, or supply chain systems.
  
**✅ Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal departments.
  
**✅ Problem\-Solving Mindset:** Ability to respond quickly to shortages, changing demand, supplier issues, and other supply challenges while developing practical solutions.
  
**✅ Organization:** Ability to manage multiple suppliers, purchase orders, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
  
**✅ Attention to Detail:** Strong commitment to accuracy when reviewing pricing, quantities, specifications, purchase orders, and supplier documentation.
  
**✅ Teamwork:** Ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Production, Sales, Quality, Receiving, and Finance to support company goals.
  
Why Join Field Fresh Foods?
  
We know that great employees are the foundation of our success, and we’re committed to providing a rewarding and supportive work environment. Here’s what we offer:
  
* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
* 401(k) to help you plan for the future
* Employee discounts on fresh products
* On\-Demand Pay – Access your earnings when you need them
* Opportunities for growth and professional development

new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------



Spectrum Building Services of America is a growing commercial facilities services company serving major national and regional customers across multiple U.S. markets.



We are looking for an experienced **Senior Financial Analyst, FP\&A** to join our finance team. This is not a bookkeeping or data\-entry position. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers, investigating why financial results changed, building financial models, and turning financial and operational data into useful information for management.



The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, accounting team, and operational leadership to provide accurate, timely, and insightful financial analysis.


**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Senior Financial Analyst will be responsible for financial planning and analysis, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial statement analysis, profitability analysis, cash\-flow forecasting, and financial modeling.



A major responsibility of this position is **cause\-of\-change and root\-cause analysis**.



We do not simply want reports showing that an expense increased or profitability declined. We expect the analyst to investigate the underlying data, determine what caused the change, quantify the major drivers, identify items requiring further investigation, and clearly communicate the findings.



You should be comfortable receiving financial information and independently asking:


* What changed?


* Why did it change?


* Does the result make sense?


* Is this an accounting issue or an actual business result?


* What are the major drivers?


* What should management pay attention to?


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Financial Statement Analysis**


* Perform monthly P\&L analysis comparing actual results to budget, forecast, prior month, and prior year.


* Perform balance\-sheet analysis and identify unusual or unexplained changes.


* Prepare monthly cause\-of\-change and variance analyses.


* Investigate significant financial variances to determine underlying drivers.


* Identify potential accounting errors or inconsistencies and work with the accounting team to investigate and resolve them.


* Prepare concise management explanations of financial performance.


### **Budgeting \& Forecasting**


* Support preparation of the annual company budget.


* Maintain rolling financial forecasts.


* Update forecasts based on actual results and changing business assumptions.


* Build revenue, labor, supply, overhead, EBITDA, and cash\-flow forecasts.


* Maintain forecast models and supporting schedules.


* Compare actual results against forecasts and explain significant differences.


### **Cash\-Flow Forecasting**


* Prepare and maintain short\- and medium\-term cash\-flow forecasts.


* Analyze expected customer receipts, payroll, vendor payments, taxes, capital expenditures, and other cash requirements.


* Identify potential cash\-flow risks and significant changes in expected cash position.


### **Profitability Analysis**



Analyze profitability by:


* Customer


* Contract


* Market/geography


* Business unit


* Other relevant operating segments



Identify the primary drivers of profitability changes, including:


* Labor hours


* Wage rates


* Overtime


* Supplies


* Pricing


* Revenue changes


* Operating expenses


* Productivity


### **Month\-End Close \& Management Reporting**



Work with the accounting team during month\-end close to:


* Review preliminary financial results.


* Perform analytical review of the P\&L and balance sheet.


* Identify unusual balances or transactions.


* Prepare supporting financial schedules.


* Track questions and exceptions requiring accounting investigation.


* Confirm that identified issues have been addressed before management reporting is finalized.


* Prepare the monthly management financial package.



The Senior Financial Analyst supports the close process through analysis and review. Accounting ownership and final accounting entries remain with the accounting function.


### **Financial Modeling \& Decision Support**



Build financial models to evaluate business decisions, including:


* New customer opportunities


* Contract pricing


* Wage increases


* Customer price increases


* Hiring decisions


* Capital investments


* Equipment and technology investments


* Cost\-reduction initiatives


* Changes in operating assumptions



Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis to show management how different assumptions affect revenue, profitability, EBITDA, and cash flow.


### **Business \& Operational Analysis**



Analyze financial and operating data to identify opportunities and risks involving:


* Labor


* Supplies


* Workers’ compensation


* Customer profitability


* Operating efficiency


* Pricing


* Overhead


* Productivity



Support management with ad hoc financial and business analysis as requested.


**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



The successful analyst does more than prepare spreadsheets.



For example, instead of reporting:


**“Supply expense was $40,000 over budget.”**



We expect analysis such as:


**“Supply expense was $40,000 over budget. Approximately $18,000 resulted from higher purchasing in Market A, $11,000 resulted from vendor price increases, $7,000 appears related to purchasing volume above expected levels, and $4,000 remains unexplained and requires additional investigation.”**



Your job is to help management understand **what happened, why it happened, and where attention is required.**

---------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.


* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in FP\&A, financial analysis, management accounting, or corporate finance.


* Strong understanding of the income stateme

* **Are you an analytical and detail\-oriented finance professional with a passion for cash forecasting, treasury management, and procurement operations?**
* **Do you enjoy working with financial data, vendor management, and process improvement initiatives that support business growth?**

  

**Who we are:**

SAI360 is giving companies a new perspective on risk management. By integrating Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC) software and Ethics \& Compliance Learning resources, SAI360 can broaden your risk horizon and increase your ability to identify, manage, and mitigate risk. See risk from every angle.


Visit www.sai360\.com .  



  

**Think you're a fit for SAI360?**

We are seeking an analytical and detail\-oriented **Financial Analyst – Treasury \& Procurement** to join our Finance team in Lithuania. This role will own the daily cash management and treasury forecasting processes, while managing procurement tracking, vendor renewals, contracts, and internal approval workflows. The ideal candidate will have experience working with ERP systems, a strong understanding of cash flows, and the ability to partner cross\-functionally with Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders. Strong Excel skills are key, along with a focus on tracking vendor lifecycles and maintaining accurate financial records.  

  

  



* Own end\-to\-end daily cash management operations and tracking processes.
* Build, maintain, and update short\- and long\-term cash flow forecasting models.
* Monitor bank accounts, track cash positioning, and perform daily treasury variance analysis.
* Actively manage and track the lifecycle of vendor contracts, including renewals and terminations.
* Coordinate internal procurement approval workflows across departments to ensure timely execution.
* Maintain the centralized vendor and contract database to track upcoming renewal dates and commitments.
* Extract, validate, and reconcile treasury and procurement data using NetSuite and other financial systems.
* Leverage advanced Excel modeling to streamline cash reporting and procurement tracking sheets.
Drive process improvements and automation in cash tracking to minimize manual input and reduce data errors.  
* 

  

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of experience in a corporate finance, treasury, or procurement/purchasing role.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required for modeling and tracking. Experience working with NetSuite or similar ERP systems is preferred.
* **Environment:** Experience working in a multinational, multi\-currency corporate environment is a plus.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively across global departments (including Accounting, Legal, and department heads) to coordinate contract approvals and verify payment commitments.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains high standards of accuracy in daily cash reconciliation, banking transactions, and contract tracking dates.
* **Problem Solving:** Proactively identifies cash discrepancies, banking issues, or upcoming contract renewal bottlenecks and works with relevant teams to resolve them.
* **Initiative:** Takes ownership of cash forecasting and vendor schedules, constantly seeking opportunities to improve procurement workflows and Excel tracking efficiency.

  

  

**Why you should apply to SAI360** **:** Alongside a remote\-first hiring strategy and competitive salary package, we offer a wide variety of employee perks including –


* PTO leave;
* Quarterly wellness days;
* EAP program;
* Healthcare benefits;
* Bonus incentives;
* Retirement savings programs;
* Professional development opportunities;
* Remote\-first work environment;

**Description**As a Finance \& Accounting Analyst at Liberty Mutual, you will be a key strategic partner to our innovative and growing **Excess Casualty** and **Mobility Solutions** underwriting teams. This role is central to driving business performance through robust financial reporting, planning, and analytics.

  

You will be responsible for the full scope of financial and operational reporting, planning, and forecasting. In this position, you will manage complex financial analysis reports and projects, leveraging **strong data stewardship and analytics** to provide strategic recommendations to the leadership of these market\-facing teams.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and enhance critical financial and operational reports, analyses, plans, and forecasts in accordance with prescribed procedures.
* Act as a **data steward** for the teams, obtaining required data for analyses from appropriate internal (e.g., general ledger, loss warehouse) or external sources in a timely, accurate, and efficient manner.
* Perform in\-depth **variance analyses** (e.g., plan vs. actual, prior year, multi\-year trends) and identify significant items requiring further investigation to support our underwriting partners.
* Ensure the timeliness, accuracy, and completeness of all reports and analyses by maintaining full documentation of recurring job duties, data sources, and assumptions.
* Partner with a **market\-facing** Excess Casualty underwriting team, providing financial insights that directly support their strategy and goals.
* Identify opportunities for efficiencies and improvements to processes, controls, and technology systems related to the functions being performed.
* Perform follow\-up investigations on financial or operational variances and suggest resolutions.


The actual internal level/grade for this role will depend on the candidate’s overall experience and skill level

* Senior Financial Analyst: $77,300\- $109,500\. Annual FTO days (Flexible Time Off): 15
* Lead Financial Analyst: $97,000 \- $138,000\. Annual FTO days (Flexible Time Off): 20
**Qualifications*** Bachelor\`s degree (Finance or Accounting) required.
* CPA or advanced degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business preferred.
* Senior\-Minimum of 3 years of finance experience.
* Lead\-Minimum of 5 years of finance experience.
* Must demonstrate attention to detail in a fast\-paced work environment and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously to drive results.
* Communicates well with own team and across organizational boundaries to ensure the successful completion of shared goals.
* Comfortable leading meetings and able to communicate issues and trends to senior management and other groups at the appropriate level of detail.
* Solid understanding of Finance Tools and Analytical Methods.
* Ability to work EST strongly preferred

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive.
